card.name: Units after lab values and weights
card.fires_on: Unit pieces such as mg, mEq, kg and /m right after a number, mostly in lab thresholds (serum phosphorus, calcium, potassium, triglycerides) or body weight tables.

modes.label: Lab threshold units
modes.description: The mg or mEq part of a unit following a serum level cutoff.
modes.example: If serum phosphate is above 7.0<< mg>>/dL, consider adding an oral phosphate

modes.label: Weight and body-surface units
modes.description: kg or /m in weight headings and per-area doses.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are conversion words, so it hints that a unit is being stated and not converted.
card.plain: It lights up on the unit written after a number, like mg/dL or mEq/L in lab cutoffs.
